data.heading: Research grounded in operating experience
data.intro: The platform should be built on a disciplined research process: practical market knowledge, official or reputable data where available, regulatory monitoring, documented experience and clearly separated opinion. High-impact commercial claims remain in the evidence register until supporting materials are prepared.
